g.text: ILLUSTRATED WIRING MAP · KiCad-derived · edit every element in Excalidraw
External 5 V input · independent jumpers · common ground
USER BUTTON · GPIO7 → momentary switch → GND
DNP allowed: motor operates normally with LED branches unpopulated
USB-C + JP1 closed: do not combine
GND is common across the controller. All 3V3 sensor supply connections come from the ESP32 regulator.
Editorial wiring infographic · not a replacement for the manufacturing schematic or electrical validation
